## 简体中文

### 修复

- 通过稳定的窗口标识匹配窗口预览、激活和关闭操作，避免重复预览以及同标题或重叠窗口导致的操作歧义。
- 预览打开期间持续刷新窗口缩略图和 Aero Peek，让实时内容、移动和尺寸变化保持同步。

## English

### Fixed

- Matched window previews, activation, and close actions by stable window identity, preventing duplicate previews and avoiding ambiguous same-title or overlapping window actions.
- Refreshed window thumbnails and Aero Peek continuously while previews are open so live content, movement, and resizing stay in sync.
